name: qa-data-quality
description: Data quality testing for analytical pipelines: dbt tests, Great Expectations, Soda checks, data contracts, and a go / no-go release gate. Extracts data contracts from data-product specs and covers tool choice and severity conventions. Agents (schema-diff-reviewer, data-anomaly-triager) review schema diffs for breaking changes and classify failed checks by anomaly type and likely owner.
